basics.name: Jun Huo
basics.label: Research Associate
basics.summary: Research Associate at the Department of Mechanical and Automation Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong. My research focuses on flexible medical robots for surgery and wearable robots for rehabilitation and assistance, including supernumerary robotic limbs (SRLs), exoskeletons, and other bio-inspired robots. My work spans mechanism design, optimization, and learning-based control.
